{
  "dataset_name": "led7",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "segment_count",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Total number of active LED segments (sum of all 7 binary attributes). Each digit has a characteristic segment count pattern.",
      "value_range": [0, 7],
      "feature_family": "aggregate",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Directly encodes the total segment activation which varies by digit class, providing a strong linear discriminant signal.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(`attribute#1`.astype(float) + `attribute#2`.astype(float) + `attribute#3`.astype(float) + `attribute#4`.astype(float) + `attribute#5`.astype(float) + `attribute#6`.astype(float) + `attribute#7`.astype(float))"
    },
    {
      "name": "segment_density",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Proportion of active segments out of 7 total, normalized to [0,1]. Provides a smooth continuous measure of segment activation density.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "normalized",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalized ratio suitable for SVM margin optimization, representing overall digit brightness/complexity.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(`attribute#1`.astype(float) + `attribute#2`.astype(float) + `attribute#3`.astype(float) + `attribute#4`.astype(float) + `attribute#5`.astype(float) + `attribute#6`.astype(float) + `attribute#7`.astype(float)) / 7.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "top_segments_sum",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of top display segments (attributes 1, 2, 3) representing the upper portion of the LED display.",
      "value_range": [0, 3],
      "feature_family": "spatial_aggregate",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures upper-half segment pattern which differs systematically across digit classes, enabling linear separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(`attribute#1`.astype(float) + `attribute#2`.astype(float) + `attribute#3`.astype(float))"
    },
    {
      "name": "bottom_segments_sum",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of bottom display segments (attributes 5, 6, 7) representing the lower portion of the LED display.",
      "value_range": [0, 3],
      "feature_family": "spatial_aggregate",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures lower-half segment pattern complementary to top segments, improving linear discriminability.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(`attribute#5`.astype(float) + `attribute#6`.astype(float) + `attribute#7`.astype(float))"
    },
    {
      "name": "top_bottom_balance",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Difference between top and bottom segment sums, measuring vertical symmetry of the digit display.",
      "value_range": [-3, 3],
      "feature_family": "contrast",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Signed contrast feature that distinguishes digits with top-heavy vs bottom-heavy segment patterns for linear SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(`attribute#1`.astype(float) + `attribute#2`.astype(float) + `attribute#3`.astype(float)) - (`attribute#5`.astype(float) + `attribute#6`.astype(float) + `attribute#7`.astype(float))"
    },
    {
      "name": "middle_segment",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Value of the middle segment (attribute 4) which is the horizontal center bar of the LED display.",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "single_segment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "The middle segment is absent in digits 0,1,7 and present in 2,3,4,5,6,8,9, providing strong discriminative power.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "`attribute#4`.astype(float)"
    },
    {
      "name": "vertical_segments_sum",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of vertical side segments (attributes 2, 3, 5, 6) representing the vertical bars of the LED display.",
      "value_range": [0, 4],
      "feature_family": "spatial_aggregate",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Vertical segment count distinguishes digits with different numbers of vertical bars, useful for linear separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(`attribute#2`.astype(float) + `attribute#3`.astype(float) + `attribute#5`.astype(float) + `attribute#6`.astype(float))"
    },
    {
      "name": "horizontal_segments_sum",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of horizontal segments (attributes 1, 4, 7) representing the three horizontal bars of the LED display.",
      "value_range": [0, 3],
      "feature_family": "spatial_aggregate",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Horizontal segment count provides complementary information to vertical segments for digit discrimination.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(`attribute#1`.astype(float) + `attribute#4`.astype(float) + `attribute#7`.astype(float))"
    },
    {
      "name": "segment_weighted_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted sum of segments with position-based weights reflecting segment discriminative importance in LED digit patterns.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.2],
      "feature_family": "weighted_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Weighted projection approximates a linear combination that separates digit groups, directly useful for SVM hyperplane.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(`attribute#1`.astype(float) * 0.6 + `attribute#2`.astype(float) * 0.7 + `attribute#3`.astype(float) * 0.5 + `attribute#4`.astype(float) * 0.8 + `attribute#5`.astype(float) * 0.4 + `attribute#6`.astype(float) * 0.5 + `attribute#7`.astype(float) * 0.7)"
    },
    {
      "name": "segment_xor_parity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Parity of total active segments (0 if even count, 1 if odd count), capturing even/odd segment activation patterns.",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "parity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Parity feature creates a binary split that correlates with certain digit groups, adding non-redundant information.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "((`attribute#1`.astype(int) + `attribute#2`.astype(int) + `attribute#3`.astype(int) + `attribute#4`.astype(int) + `attribute#5`.astype(int) + `attribute#6`.astype(int) + `attribute#7`.astype(int)) % 2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "segment_activation_complexity",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of how complex or ambiguous the segment pattern is for digit recognition, based on the combination of active segments. Higher values indicate patterns that are harder to uniquely identify as a single digit.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_complexity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures perceptual ambiguity of segment patterns which may correlate with misclassification boundaries in SVM margin space.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "display_symmetry_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of left-right and top-bottom symmetry in the LED segment pattern. Symmetric digits like 0, 8 score high; asymmetric digits like 2, 3 score low.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_symmetry",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Symmetry is a perceptual feature that groups digits into symmetric vs asymmetric clusters, providing smooth continuous signal for SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
